entries.task: Fix: arena squid enemy stands still (reported by user). Diagnose and wire its movement.

files_modified.reason: Root cause: the squid behavior was half-implemented — helpers (_face_squid/_squid_attach/_squid_detach), the squid_clinging-group ship slow (arena.gd ~323), the tentacle wrap draw, and the plume modulation all existed, but _tick_behavior() had NO "squid" case, so behavior=="squid" fell through the match with zero movement -> the squid never moved or latched on. The case had existed in commit b9209fc ('Squid enemy: ... jump+cling behavior') and was lost at some point. Restored the ORIGINAL leap-based logic (user recalled the leap): _jump_tick(delta, dir, false) octopus-rhythm leaps toward the player led by the tentacles; on reaching _radius+SQUID_ATTACH_RANGE -> _squid_attach (joins squid_clinging -> slows ship, no contact dmg since def contact=0); while clinging lerp toward pp+_squid_attach_off to ride with the ship; detach only when the player escapes (dist > 3x reach). The _phase/_timer reset inside _squid_detach now correctly restarts the jump cycle. (First attempt this session used a continuous chase + 3s timer detach + a SQUID_CLING_TIME const; replaced with the original leap behavior and the const removed.)

entries.changes_summary: Squid enemy was standing still because arena_enemy._tick_behavior() lacked a "squid" branch despite all supporting squid code being present. Restored the original leap+cling behavior from commit b9209fc: octopus-rhythm leaps in toward the player (via _jump_tick), latch onto the ship and slow it, ride along while clinging, release only when the player dashes away.

entries.task: Rewrite the Swarm (Chakra) weapon from scratch: 8 swarmballs launch out, loiter to acquire a target, then charge + ram as swarmbots and explode. (The old dart+heal familiar belongs to Vampire Host, which is untouched.)

files_modified.lines: SBALL_* consts + DeathFX preload (~211); swarm state vars (~740); _load_swarm_tex/_load_sball_tex (~3395); activate_swarm + _launch_swarm_volley + _tick_swarm + _swarm_ball_hit_enemy + _acquire_swarm_target + _nearest_in_groups + _swarm_impact (~3556); _draw_swarm (~4226)
files_modified.reason: New Swarm mechanic per spec: volley of SBALL_COUNT=8 balls fired in evenly-spaced directions, fly out to SBALL_LAUNCH_RADIUS=300 @500px/s, loiter (wander) @200px/s for 1.5s, then acquire a target by priority — enemies (highest HP, ties->nearest) > ruins > asteroids — and charge @500px/s. Within SBALL_ARM_DIST=300 it swaps Swarmball.png -> Swarmbot.png; on reaching the target (or colliding with ANY enemy en route) it deals 5 dmg (level/crit-scaled via _roll_damage) and spawns a half-size enemy-kill burst (DeathFX, size 18). New volley after SBALL_COOLDOWN=3s once the pool is spent; SBALL_MAX_LIFE=9s backstop. Sprites drawn via draw_texture_rect at 20px width (ratio-kept), 24px for the bot. Reused _swarm_units/_swarm_active/_swarm_init; old SWARM_* constants kept (Vampire Host still uses SWARM_COUNT/IDLE_R/SPEED/AGGRO/HIT_RADIUS/DAMAGE/COL).

NOTE: arena asteroids are currently decorative (no per-rock HP/take_damage), so asteroid targeting falls back to nearest Node2D in debug_asteroid/arena_asteroids and may be a no-op until a damageable asteroid entity exists. The leftover swarm plume registration (ND-OIF-F, 2 anchors) still attaches to 2 balls — cosmetic; real per-ball trails come from the TP plume work below.

entries.task: Swarmball tweaks: (1) anchor balls to the player during launch+loiter (move with the ship until they charge); (2) acquire target from the PLAYER position, not each ball.

files_modified.lines: SBALL_LAUNCH_RADIUS 300->50 (earlier); _launch_swarm_volley dict (off/dir, dropped vel/origin); _tick_swarm launch/loiter/charge + ang; _acquire_swarm_target() now arg-less
files_modified.reason: (1) Balls now store an 'off' (offset from the player); launch grows the offset out to SBALL_LAUNCH_RADIUS and loiter ORBITS the player at SBALL_LOITER_SPEED — both phases set pos = player_pos + off, so the swarm stays anchored to the ship until it locks a target and enters 'charge' (world-space flight). Facing 'ang' now derives from actual per-frame movement. (2) _acquire_swarm_target() measures distances from _player.global_position (ties among highest-HP enemies, plus ruin/asteroid fallback) so all 8 balls converge on the same target. Mid-flight collision still uses the ball's own position.

entries.task: Swarmball: orbit radius 100; orbit-contact chip damage (no consume); on target death mid-charge, survivors re-loiter around the death spot then re-target.

files_modified.lines: SBALL_LAUNCH_RADIUS 200->100 + SBALL_LOITER_HIT_CD (~213); _tick_swarm loiter/charge rework + new reloiter state; new _swarm_loiter_contact() (~3703)
files_modified.reason: (1) orbit radius 100. (2) While orbiting (loiter OR reloiter), _swarm_loiter_contact deals SBALL_DAMAGE (5, level/crit-scaled) + a DeathFX burst to any grazed enemy WITHOUT removing the ball, rate-limited per ball by SBALL_LOITER_HIT_CD (0.3s). (3) In charge, the ball remembers its target's last position (last_tp); if the target dies before impact, the ball switches to a new 'reloiter' state that orbits b['center'] = the death spot for SBALL_LOITER_TIME (1.5s), then re-acquires via the original player-based _acquire_swarm_target and charges again. life resets whenever a target is (re)acquired so productive balls aren't culled by SBALL_MAX_LIFE. Mid-flight detonation collision is now gated to state=='charge' only. Volley spawn/cooldown is untouched (independent).
